sync_clock.description: Synchronize stove time and date with the current Home Assistant time and date.

user.title: Micronova Agua IOT options
user.description: Language, timeouts and the update interval apply to every stove. Set Cloud, Bluetooth or local MQTT, and the Jolly Mec and Bronpi fixes, on the stove row.

mqtt_settings.title: MQTT connection
mqtt_settings.description: Leave the host empty to use Home Assistant MQTT. Password blank keeps the saved password. Application write receipts must be supported by the endpoint. Leave them disabled for ordinary brokers.

data_description.allow_eeprom_writes: On by default. The default is 3 commands per hour and 5 commands per day per stove. On this row you can raise that to 15 per hour and 50 per day. The hourly value stays at or below the daily value. Cloud, Bluetooth and local MQTT share the count. Cloud and Bluetooth give the count back when the write fails. MQTT gives it back only when the command was not sent. Turn off to block these writes from this integration.
data_description.max_eeprom_writes_per_hour: Default 3. Highest value is 15. Stays at or below the daily value.
